modelRules.cancelRule: after fulfillment, cancel remaining order if currentDay - acceptedDay >= maxWait
modelRules.stockoutRule: available inventory before shipment < min(orders waiting, daily capacity)
modelRules.cashLowPoint: minimum of D0 after advance purchase and daily closing cash
modelRules.inTransit: paid on purchase day; still an asset until receipt
modelRules.initialStock: owned before the window; no duplicate current-window purchase payment
